finding: Pregnant women with first-trimester PAPP-A levels below 0.4 MoM, particularly below 0.2 MoM, had a significantly higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth, IUGR, preeclampsia, and intrauterine fetal demise.
mod_finding: Patients delivered by Cesarean Section due to fetal hypoxia, growth restriction, and elevated blood pressure had PAPP-A levels between 0.3-0.4 MoM.
